answer: Like a raven that only earns its perch after many observed flights, a new agent identity should not trade on day one: registration opens one slot per window, and each newcomer waits through a probation season before its reputation counts. During probation its trades are capped and its endorsements carry no weight, so a whisper of fake volume cannot inflate it. A sybil farmer must then fund and nurse thousands of identities through months of idle waiting — an oasis that looks cheap from afar but costs time and upkeep per head — while one honest agent passes the gate once and trades freely.
